 -Ms. Babita Kumari Sahu, Aga.
Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice A.C. Behera

Order
Order No. 12.11.2024
 04. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (Virtual/ Physical) mode.

2. This bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 of the Petitioner arising out of Special G.R. Case No.03of 2023 in connection with Biridi P.S. Case No.304 of 2023 is taken up for consideration.

3. The bail application is heard only from the learned Counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State, as the Informant did not choose to participate in the hearing of the bail application inspite of service of notice.
4. The Petitioner is facing trial in the Court of learned Adhoc Addl.
District & Sessions Judge (FTC)-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Jagatsinghpur
in Special G.R. Case No.03 of 2023.

5. As per the rejection order of bail of the Petitioner, the Petitioner is facing trial having been charged under Section- 363/366/365/376(2)(n)/376(3) of the IPC read with Section-6 of the POCSO Act for commission of continuous rape on minor victim.

The case against the Petitioner is at the fag end of its trial, because by the time of rejection of bail of the Petitioner on dated 22.04.2024, ten (10) witnesses had already been examined on behalf of the prosecution.
As the case against the Petitioner is at the fag end of the trial, for which, it is not felt proper to allow the Petitioner to go on bail, in these heinous nature of allegations against him.
Therefore, the prayer for bail of the Petitioner is refused.
6. Accordingly, his bail application stands rejected.
